about: The mutant ledger of runtime/obs (RT-OBS): edits of the Go-trace sink that a test of the package must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants runtime/obs/testdata/mutants.json.

mutants.name: obs-flat-tasks
mutants.rule: Each Ergo task is a Go user task under its parent's Go task.

mutants.name: obs-no-region
mutants.rule: Each capability call is a region of its task.

mutants.name: obs-no-labels
mutants.rule: A task's goroutine, and those it starts, carry the label ergo.def.

mutants.name: obs-flight-no-dump
mutants.rule: A defect writes the flight recorder's window.
